scan.title: Scan — {root}
scan.configHint: Depth is configurable from 1 to 20 and the exclusion list is editable (D-04, D-05) — a later stage

skipHint.submodule: .git is a file — add it by hand if needed (D-06)
skipHint.noAccess: os error 13 — permission denied; fix the rights and rescan
skipHint.nonUtf8: the path contains characters outside UTF-8 — rename it and rescan
skipHint.archived: already an archived project — restore it from the archived list
skipHint.inExclusions: the path was added to the exclusions list by hand

settings.title: Project settings
settings.nameHint: Name: 1–100 characters after trimming. Label: 1–6 visible characters, case is kept (DB-042).
settings.paletteHint: Fixed 12-color palette (DB-040); if no color is chosen, the app assigns the least used one (PRJ-010, D-29).
settings.schemeA: — full overwrite of the main file
settings.schemeB: — write into a marked area <!-- EUNOMIASYNC:BEGIN -->…<!-- EUNOMIASYNC:END -->
settings.schemeC: {letter} — separate {stem} file; the app never edits the main file
settings.extraHint: {local} is usually not added to Git; the app does not edit {gitignore}.
settings.schemeBHint: The file must contain exactly one marker pair, each marker on its own line; the app does not insert them itself.
settings.schemeCHint: Add this line to the main file yourself (D-20, D-21):
settings.snippet: If {file} exists in the repository root, read it before starting work and follow its instructions.
settings.dirtyHint: Changing the scheme or the file name makes the project dirty; the old file is not deleted (DB-023).
settings.backupsHint: Up to 10 backups are kept per file; restoring from a backup is a later stage (D-17).
settings.archiveHint: Nothing on disk changes; the project stops taking part in syncs (PRJ-013…018).

preview.title: File preview
preview.emptyNote: No instructions assigned — the next sync would leave the file without instruction texts.

archive.title: Archive project
archive.intro: "{name}" will be archived. The project folder is not touched, assignments are kept, and the project stops taking part in syncs
archive.scanSuffix: ; its path goes to the exclusions list
archive.wayBack: . You can restore it later from the "Archived projects" screen.
archive.inputLabel: Type the project name to confirm

archived.title: Archived projects
archived.subtitle: Archived projects keep their assignments, do not take part in syncs, and their folders are not touched (DB-014).
archived.hint: If you add the folder of an archived project again, the app offers to restore it (DB-015).

restore.title: Restore project
restore.text: "{name}" will be restored. The project comes back active with all its assignments, and its path is removed from the excluded paths so a scan can find it again.

excluded.title: Excluded paths
excluded.subtitle: Paths in this list are skipped by the repository scan. Removing an entry makes the path findable again (D-10).
excluded.hint: New exclusions appear here when a scanned project is archived (PRJ-017) or when a path is excluded manually.

removeExclusion.title: Remove excluded path
removeExclusion.text: "{path}" will be removed from the excluded paths. The path will be found by the scan again, and its projects can be added as usual.
